name: notes
title: Notes
description: Local markdown notes and tasks, no limits. Forked from Noteman.
author: c-wenlong

commands.name: toggleNotesWindow
commands.title: Toggle Notes Window
commands.description: Show or hide the floating notes window (bind to ⌥⌘N)

commands.name: browseNotes
commands.title: Browse Notes
commands.description: Browse, search, pin, and manage your notes

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.description: Open tasks across all notes, toggle done with Enter

preferences.name: notesFolderPath
preferences.title: Notes Folder Path
preferences.description: Folder where markdown notes are stored

scripts.test: esbuild test/lib.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --alias:@raycast/api=./test/raycast-stub.js --outfile=dist/test.cjs --log-level=warning && node dist/test.cjs && npm run test-helper && npm run test-view && npm run test-attachments
scripts.test-helper: mkdir -p dist && swiftc -swift-version 5 -o dist/list-tests helper/ListEditing.swift helper/Dates.swift helper/NoteNames.swift helper/NoteLinks.swift helper/Titles.swift test/list-editing/main.swift && dist/list-tests
scripts.test-view: mkdir -p dist && swiftc -swift-version 5 -o dist/view-tests helper/Markdown.swift helper/Highlighter.swift helper/NoteTextView.swift helper/ListEditing.swift helper/Chrome.swift helper/ActionPalette.swift helper/Links.swift helper/NoteLinks.swift helper/NoteNames.swift helper/InlinePicker.swift helper/SlashMenu.swift helper/Emoji.swift helper/CodeBlocks.swift helper/Zoom.swift helper/Titles.swift helper/Dates.swift helper/Theme.swift helper/Attachment.swift helper/SettingsPopover.swift test/text-view/shim.swift test/text-view/main.swift && dist/view-tests dist/view-selection.png
scripts.test-attachments: mkdir -p dist && sed '/MARK: - Entry point/,$d' helper/main.swift > dist/main.swift && cat test/attachments/main.swift >> dist/main.swift && swiftc -swift-version 5 -o dist/attachment-tests dist/main.swift $(ls helper/*.swift | grep -v /main.swift) test/attachments/*-review.swift test/attachments/review-regressions.swift && dist/attachment-tests
scripts.render-panel: mkdir -p dist && sed '/MARK: - Entry point/,$d' helper/main.swift > dist/main.swift && sed '/^import /d' test/panel-render/main.swift >> dist/main.swift && swiftc -swift-version 5 -o dist/render-panel dist/main.swift $(ls helper/*.swift | grep -v /main.swift) && dist/render-panel
